public_gates: design frozen actor shadow head objective
define feature views and source-heldout splits
define normal retention and wrong-history sequence-gap metrics
keep actor coupling, PPO, and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train in the design milestone
do not use privileged or label inputs in actor
do not treat shadow-head success as closed-loop proof
hypothesis: A frozen-actor shadow response-amplifier design can test whether fused/hidden feature views can support sustained wrong-history action separation while preserving normal near-boundary behavior.
success_criteria: design defines shadow module and feature views
design defines normal anchor and wrong-history sequence-separation losses
design defines source-heldout split and multi-seed pass criteria
design defines exact evaluator required before actor coupling
failure_criteria: design treats shadow success as promotion evidence
decision_rule: M670 passes only if it designs a frozen-actor shadow objective that can be evaluated exactly before any actor update is admitted.
